audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart said Skill / Vayne / Vayne / Skill / Skill / Vayne / Vayne, which contradicts both the packet chart and the content-layer whys (Karma clearly owns 1-3, Vayne owns everything after).
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Karma, Karma, Karma, Vayne, Vayne, Vayne, Vayne, and the prose already describes exactly that curve. 44.68% win rate over 47 games fits an early-strong, late-losing lane.
audit.corrected: Both layers set to Karma x3 then Vayne x4, proposed in matched pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phase whys were generic Karma boilerplate ('the lane is a toll booth and you own it', 'his farming spots') and named no Vayne spike at all.
audit.why: The real spikes are her first attack-speed item (Silver Bolts' percent-max-HP true damage becomes live) and Final Hour at 6, which grants invisibility during Tumble and cuts its cooldown. Karma has no level-6 spike because Mantra is available from level 1.
audit.corrected: Rewrote phases[0..6].why around Silver Bolts, Final Hour and Condemn's real cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Tumble's auto-attack reset was never mentioned, and breakdown.cooldowns gave Condemn no number.
audit.why: Tumble (Q) is a 6/5/4/3/2s auto-reset — the burst tell is the attack wind-up, not the ability cast. Condemn is 20/18/16/14/12s at 550 range and only stuns on terrain collision. Silver Bolts is true damage, so Karma's shield mitigates it but no resistance does.
audit.corrected: Put the Tumble reset tell and Condemn's rank-1/rank-5 cooldowns into breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flagged 'Land Focused Resolve' and 'Her Silver Bolts' as probable wrong names.
audit.why: Both are false positives: Focused Resolve is Karma's real W and Silver Bolts is Vayne's real W.

edits.before: Q poke at level 1 is among the best in the game — chunk Vayne on every last-hit and start the Mantra economy.
edits.after: RQ Soulflare out-ranges her auto-only level 1 — chunk Vayne on every last-hit and start the Mantra economy.

edits.before: W tether threatens the root — anyone who steps to you early eats Q-W and donates the trade.
edits.after: Inner Flame poke plus Gathering Fire refunds while she farms attack speed — deny her the safe lane.

edits.before: Full kit: E shield-speed makes you untouchable in short trades. Mantra-Q (RQ) on cooldown gaps is a third of his HP.
edits.after: Q and RQ rotations shove an immobile-early Vayne off the wave; no item sustain yet, so every poke sticks and plates fall.

edits.before: Spam the RQ slow-field on his farming spots and keep your shield for Condemn — the lane is a toll booth and you own it.
edits.after: Her Condemn is 20s at rank 1 but her attack speed is arriving — walking up to poke now costs more than it wins.

edits.before: No new ultimate at 6 — your Mantra has been online since level 1. His spike is the danger window: respect it.
edits.after: Final Hour grants invisibility during Tumble and cuts its cooldown — you can't track her, Silver Bolts is true damage.

edits.before: First item amplifies the RQ chunk — keep him under 60% and the lane stays yours by default.
edits.after: First attack-speed item makes Silver Bolts' percent-HP true damage live — poke stops trading even.

edits.before: You drift toward utility now — peel, shield, and speed your carries while the RQ poke softens objectives.
edits.after: She out-scales with no answer from your kit — peel, don't duel; every long fight past two items goes to Vayne.

edits.before: His dash beats your poke rhythm — shield the engage, root the exit, and respect the all-in windows.
edits.after: Win levels 1-3 or lose the lane — her Tumble reset is the tell, and Condemn ends you against a wall.

edits.before: Tax the approach, survive the dive, and grind him down between windows. Nothing here works through Condemn — schedule your pattern around its cooldown.
edits.after: Build the lead before her first attack-speed item, then stop dueling. Condemn is 20s at rank 1 — never step up with a wall behind you while it's up.

edits.before: - Vayne Condemn: matchup-defining — Wall-stun — never fight her with terrain at your back. It governs your forward steps. - E shield spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Vayne Condemn: 20s at rank 1, 12s at rank 5 — never fight her with terrain at your back. - Tumble is an auto-attack reset: the wind-up is your cue to step back, not the cast. - Hold E for her commit, never for poke.

edits.before: Open the toll booth: Q every last-hit, RQ the cooldown gaps, and hold E strictly for Condemn. The lane is yours until he spikes.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are yours and this lane only gets worse: RQ Soulflare her every step-up, Q every last-hit, and hold E for Condemn.
